description: This file defines a React functional component 'Navbar' that implements a sticky navigation bar with smooth scrolling, scrollspy functionality using IntersectionObserver, and accessibility features for keyboard navigation. The component manages active section states and dynamically highlights the corresponding navigation link as the user scrolls through different sections of a webpage.

methods.name: Navbar
methods.description: React functional component implementing a sticky navigation bar with scrollspy and accessibility features.

methods.name: onJump
methods.description: Handles smooth scrolling to a section when a navigation link is clicked.
